item.title: Anthropic announces closing of initial public offering, including full exercise of…

item.title: Inkling 2 Mini: Reasoning model for laptops and real-time tasks
item.description: Inkling 2 Mini, a looped transformer model, is released. It runs middle layers three times per words to enhance reasoning and reduce words usage. It has compact scale and can run on consumer laptops. The model addresses the need for powerful reasoning capabilities on limited hardware, such as laptops, for tasks requiring detailed processing. — Upstream (Hacker News): https://thinkingmachines.ai/news/inkling-2-mini/
